maximum_claim: GEOMETRICALLY AND KINEMATICALLY ADMISSIBLE AT THE EVALUATED CAD FIDELITY

phase_b_dynamics_cross_reference.relationship_to_phase_a: Phase A is geometry and kinematics measured on B-rep solids, with no force anywhere. Phase B is rigid-body dynamics at an IDEAL-JOINT fidelity, with no contact anywhere. Neither supersedes the other and neither is a contact model.
what_it_added: the assembled rigid-body mechanism completes a 0-360 degree crank cycle
platform displacement under the constrained model
actuator torque under declared mass, density, damping and speed assumptions
incremental 1 kg payload torque, which is independent of the density assumptions
unactuated back-driving tendency at eight release angles

what_it_did_not_change.REQ-003_payload_capacity: UNSUPPORTED, unchanged. A rigid-body reaction force is not a stress and this model computes none (UNR-BM-002-007).
what_it_did_not_change.REQ-005_safety: INDETERMINATE, unchanged. No criterion is stated.
what_it_did_not_change.REQ-007_jamming: NOT_VERIFIED, unchanged. The guide is an IDEAL prismatic constraint; no contact is resolved (NRM-BM-002-014, NEG-BM-002-011).
what_it_did_not_change.holding_after_release: informed, not required. The source states no holding requirement (UNR-BM-002-004).

requirement_readings.requirement: REQ-001 external crank raises and lowers an internal platform
requirement_readings.why: kinematic evidence over a complete cycle with the chain traversable

requirement_readings.outcome: PASS on the structural predicate; numeric acceptance bounded
requirement_readings.why: measured 90.000000 mm, mid-band. The compliance edge of 'approximately' stays unresolved (UNR-BM-002-002); it does not bite at 90 mm.

a payload is declared with its unit and a complete load path exists, but no strength evidence exists at any fidelity (DOS-BM-002 S5). Per s11 this is UNSUPPORTED: an evidence state, not a product verdict.

requirement_readings.requirement: REQ-004 mechanism remains enclosed during normal operation
requirement_readings.why: the crank arm, connecting rod, both pins and the platform are inside the housing at every sampled state, and the +X side is closed by the rear panel. Whether the boundary-crossing hub itself counts as part of 'the mechanism' is AMB-002-01 and is not decided (UNR-BM-002-001).
no safety criterion is stated (UNR-BM-002-005) and no evidence addresses safety

requirement_readings.outcome: PARTIAL: installation processes exist; the rest NOT_VERIFIED
requirement_readings.requirement: REQ-006 mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture
requirement_readings.why: every discretely installed body has a swept, unobstructed installation path and the order is acyclic. Assembly effort, tooling and manufacturability have no evidence.

requirement_readings.requirement: REQ-007 avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation
requirement_readings.why: jamming is contact-level. All corpus evidence is V-A declared-pair and may not be cited for engagement (NRM-BM-002-014). No V-B evidence exists, and no jamming criterion is stated (UNR-BM-002-005).
produced envelope is 125 x 140 x 224 mm including the handle. No envelope is stated to compare it against (UNR-BM-002-006).
no powered or stored-energy element exists in any body or scenario object

scope_warning: These are GEOMETRIC and KINEMATIC results. They do not establish that the rank-1 source is satisfied, and they establish nothing about strength, effort, jamming, safety or manufacturability.
